value.rationale: The result is a full rankwise covariance-sign classification for natural BST shape statistics, not a single arbitrary small parameter. It explains a counterintuitive boundary-dominated positive aggregate despite negative covariances with every other individual leaf indicator. A precisely quantified nonmonotone regression shows why positive covariance does not imply positive monotone conditional dependence. Exact finite laws and a nonzero asymptotic limit supply reusable dependence information.
